name: Codex ngrok A2A endpoint
summary: Create an A2A-friendly endpoint so employer agents can provide context to employee Codex agents.

context.currentGoal: Provide project context to employees through their agent endpoints.
context.background: Employees expose local or ngrok-backed Codex context intake agents. HR owns project context and dispatches updates.

constraints: Do not send secrets unless explicitly approved.
Prefer structured JSON payloads with source links and acceptance criteria.
acceptanceCriteria: HR agent stores employee agent endpoints.
HR agent dispatches context through A2A JSON-RPC or REST.
